hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Find the maximum element in the array first.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use a sliding window where the right pointer expands and the left pointer contracts whenever the window contains at least k max elements.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: When the window contains at least k max elements, every subarray ending at right and starting from 0 up to left contains at least k max elements.
